teaching.task: Predict the limiting reactant using reaction capacity, calculate theoretical yield, and account for leftovers. Requires moles, molar mass and balanced equations.
teaching.causalExplanation: Coefficients state the amount required per equation-sized reaction. The smallest amount divided by its coefficient sets the limit; product and consumed excess follow that reaction amount.

Short board labels support the current spoken reason; faithful captions remain unchanged.
